summary: verify.sh printed n/a - no terraform in this repo in the two repos that are nothing but Terraform. Detection considered only modules/ and (for siblings) infra/; both fleets keep every .tf in terraform/, so tf_dirs came out empty and the gate skipped. A third repo, biffo-plugin-idea-scout, had the same layout and was unknown until the estate was swept. Local-only in severity — both fleets' CI does check it — but that is exactly this gate's job, and its own failure text promises to catch things before "three minutes and a merge race later". The message was the worse half: "no terraform in this repo" is a false claim *about the repo*, where the truth was "none in the two directories I look in" — the same scope-shrinking shape as protection-audit.sh dropping repos with no dev (#1145)
